regierung.intro: You set the course. Ministries allocate goods and arrange transport within available capacity.
regierung.kurs: Who takes priority during a shortage?
regierung.kursPreis: Course change: 3 political capital · binding for 30 days. Factions react according to their ideology; parliamentary guarantees may bind for longer.
regierung.ausgewogen: Share scarcity. Civilian needs and fronts share available supplies.
regierung.zivil: People first. Domestic supply takes priority; the army receives less fuel when supplies are scarce.
regierung.militaer: Operations first. More fuel for the front; civilian shortages hurt production and trust in government.
regierung.kursBindung: The agreed course is still binding. Its end date is shown beside the course.
regierung.schutz.kurz: Save energy and retain stocks at home.
regierung.schutz.wirtschaft: 90 days: civilian gas and oil demand −10%. Steel, electronics and fertiliser output −5%. Food, medicine and fertiliser exports pause, retaining stocks but losing export revenue.
regierung.schutz.innen: Mandatory savings cost 0.25 government trust points each monthly settlement. Actual supply recovery can restore trust.
regierung.schutz.aussen: Affected export customers lose 1 trust and trade willingness point on enactment. The package ends automatically after 90 days.
regierung.energie.kurz: Additional gas at a higher cost and greater dependence.
regierung.energie.wirtschaft: After 30 days, for 180 days: additional gas up to 20% of normal monthly demand, only when procurement falls short. Price premium 20%. Actual deliveries enter trade and foreign exchange accounts.
regierung.energie.innen: More gas can stabilise power and industry. Ports and pipelines limit what reaches users; signing alone earns no approval.
regierung.energie.aussen: Actual deliveries strengthen relations with the partner. War, trade bans, sanctions or trust below 40 suspend additional supplies.
regierung.netz.kurz: A ministry mandate instead of repairing each route manually.
regierung.netz.wirtschaft: After 21 days, for 90 days: repair up to four of the most damaged safe corridors per monthly settlement, removing up to 35 percentage points of damage each. The budget is debt-financed once.
regierung.netz.innen: The ministry prioritises by damage. Lasting repairs improve access to goods; trust rises only if supply actually improves.
regierung.netz.aussen: Occupied or contested routes and front corridors are excluded. Military blockades require security or de-escalation.
regierung.partnerGesperrt: War or a trade restriction prevents this agreement.
regierung.partnerVertrauen: The partner requires at least 40 trust points.
regierung.keinSchaden: No safe, damaged domestic corridors currently qualify.
regierung.laeuft: Already enacted; duplicate orders are not possible.
regierung.preis: Introduction: {pk} political capital · if passed, base cost {bip}% GDP; compromises may change this.
regierung.beschlossen: Enacted: {name}. Implementation appears in the monthly accounts.
regierung.beendet: Programme ended. Ministries have returned to normal rules.
regierung.abrechnung: Goods, repairs and political responses settle monthly. Lead times indicate the earliest readiness date.
regierung.methodik: ¹ Average coverage across civilian commodity groups, not a population share. Trust contribution includes supply changes and policy burdens; other government effects apply separately.
regierung.berichtGas: Additional gas: {menge} bn m³ · premium: {preis} bn USD · partner: {land}
regierung.erholung: Civilian supply has recovered. Average coverage is back to at least 95%.
regierung.exportReaktion: Temporary export restrictions to protect essential supplies.
regierung.partnerReaktion: Additional gas delivered under the supply agreement.
regierung.mapNormal: Set priorities, secure an energy partner or restore safe transport routes. Ministries organise distribution.
regierung.mapBlockiert: Enemy control interrupts this route. Supply policy only allocates goods that can reach their destination; this blockade needs a military or diplomatic solution.
regierung.mapKnapp: Missing supplies weaken operations and can affect civilian production and prices. Review government priorities alongside domestic supply.
regierung.lieferungUnbekannt: No monthly accounts for this front yet.
regierung.schutzBindung: The protection package determines this export policy until it expires.
